comparator.role: the sealed AGREE arm, context beside the A/A, never the bar

in_chain_replicate.role: the within-chain null the delta is read at (the attempt id is the coordinator's registration; read it from that package if it differs)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim, never a generalisation claim, and it admits nothing beyond the no-harm entry it is registered for. No utterance text, transcript, gold label string, knowledge body or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: NO-HARM READ (owner decision 164 brief, row 139): against the SHARED wave-1 in-chain A/A SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WAVE1-AA-FOLD-A-V1 flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (primary, decision 133) is not below -0.9943 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (the guard) is not below -1.2485 pp -- each metric read at its own Fold A own-null half-width (docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). A CI that includes zero and clears the margin is the admission. The cell is NEVER reported as a gain whatever the point estimate: no measured conversion applies to contrast text, so no expected effect is declared (decision 139). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the row-level attribution of the delta to the rows the contrast lines newly name (membership fixed in offline-estimates-v1.json before contact), and the A/A's own delta against the sealed AGREE arm as the instrument's reading.

membership_sets.note: the offline read's Fold A counts define the attribution groups; the per-row membership is recomputed by the same script at read time from the same pinned inputs and must reproduce these counts exactly

steps: 1. Refuse unless BOTH the W3 arm and the shared A/A SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WAVE1-AA-FOLD-A-V1 carry a COMPLETE sealed manifest at 1,080 rows with the committed roster's ids, each with one successful complete official TRAIN score, and their config hashes are the registered ones.

2. Structural stage: on the arm, the Perception consumption's delivered boundary ids must equal the AGREE arm's on every row (W3 moves no key); the Solver consumption must equal the AGREE arm's 20 exemplars on every row (W3a moves no exemplar; the offline read's validation re-derived them 1080 of 1080); the delivered card bodies must hash to the contrast release. A mismatch is an engineering defect, not an effect, and closes the read.
3. Score once per arm over the complete manifest with the standard scorer (slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch, never sharded).

4. Paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260927) of the arm minus shared A/A delta on intent accuracy and on official pooled SLU-F1; the same against the sealed AGREE arm BESIDE it, never instead of it.

5. Apply the no-harm rule: ADMITTED iff the intent lower bound >= -0.9943 and the SLU lower bound >= -1.2485; HARMFUL iff either upper bound < 0 (decision 25); otherwise NOT ADMITTED (width). Never write 'gain' or 'no gain'.
6. Row attribution: the intent transition table (A/A -> arm) on the rows whose chosen-vs-gold pair the contrast lines newly name and on the rest -- counts only.

7. Report beside every number: the per-scenario table in the natural-mixture and equal-scenario weightings; the frontier row (decision 75); the Solver prompt tokens per contact from the sealed COST records against the A/A; the A/A's own delta against the sealed AGREE arm as the instrument's reading.
title: Cell W3 -- the standard paired roster read on intent + SLU at the shared wave-1 in-chain A/A, under the no-harm rule, with row attribution to the fixed contrast membership set (W3a alone)
